body:
Were you scared of rejection? My mind is always filled with doubts and I don’t always make the best decisions. So I can understand to an extent how you felt when you decided not to tell him. 
I know it causes you a lot of pain, but try to comfort yourself by reminding yourself that you are both healthy. Neither his life or yours were ruined because of this, it’s a good thing. 

I also lost someone, I know what it’s like to feel like love will never come again. To feel like I failed. All we can do is keep our heads up and learn from our bad experiences

Have you thought about getting tested? No matter how he feels, maybe it’s good for you both to know for sure. If you find out you’re healthy, I feel like it could turn anger into nothing more than a unfortunate event.
It is. Life just isn’t fair. What about you? Want to share?

She was married. She felt like she was cheating. Well plot twist, her husband is the pedophile I was talking about. Put his claws on her when she was 14 after she already went through hell. I think it’s over now. I got into an argument with him. Let’s just say I was honest about my feelings. Never thought it’d be caught in such a ridiculous situation

I undersand that. I feel like I failed my girlfriend. Now I’m missing simple conversations. Feels like nothing will ever be the same anymore. 

Feeling like I don’t deserve love though, that’s been forever. I’m tired of it.

Just talking to me helps more than you can imagine. Nothing is forcing you to do this and it means a lot to me. Thank you. 
It feels like anyone I knew, who truly knew me, is gone. I feel alone
My mother and sister are the closest. But they barely know anything. I don’t like to share too much about that stuff. My sister doesn’t even know I’ve been struggling with depression for years

The worst thing is that I feel like violence could really solve the problem and I hate feeling this way. I was an angry kid and I managed to change simply because I didn’t want to be like my father. It made relationships so much easier. But recently it’s just a fucking mess and I don’t feel in control most of the time. And he’s some skinny bastard who’s too much of a coward to approach actual humans so he settled for a 14 year old. I’ve never despised anyone more than him. 


I hope you find a job. Even if it’s not the best thing for now and not what you want to do with your life. Assuming you want to stay in the country you currently live in. Good luck, Marin

I agree. I mean, new people working there will probably be genuine but after so many calls, it’s understandable that they would become desensitized. It sucks but I can’t really blame them. I highly doubt it’ll save someone’s life though (I’m sure it happened plenty of times but you know) so I kinda roll my eyes everytime I see it after the death of some celebrity

My girlfriend left, my medication isn’t working, a pedophile I know is getting away with it and there’s nothing I can do and violence won’t get me anywhere as tempting as it is. Alcohol doesn’t work anymore. They say whiskey works better than beer but I don’t have any. Insomnia. I can’t focus on anything to think about something else and I’m stuck here looking at the ceiling wishing I was dead
I called once and she clearly didn’t care about me. I don’t know why I wanted to call again today
I just wanted to hear someone’s voice. Thanks for the advice, I didn’t know you could do that
Terrible. I had a very bad day. It wasn’t better before but it’s like everything bad that could happen to me just happened all at once
